consequence.statement: A Go patch-version bump in the build toolchain needs no operator action.

assertion.statement: The Go version used to build external-secrets was bumped from 1.24.1 to 1.24.2, a routine Dependabot build-dependency update.

proposal.undeterminedReason: subject: The text says only 'bump golang'. It does not say whether this is the golang builder image or the Go toolchain version, so no subject family or exact identity can be named.; applicability: This is a build-time dependency of the product's own artifacts. Nothing in an operator's configuration selects or exposes it, and the evidence names no affected environment state.
